challenge.better_approach: Making rung 4 require a non-empty answer was looked at; it would also refuse any legacy resolved record without one, a wider change than the measured gap. The withdrawn check is exact.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That withdrawn is the only resolved-without-answer shape. Measured: answer() refuses an empty answer, so only withdraw writes one.
challenge.prior_art: ruling_refusal's existing resolved check (ticket 37ddc47686c2) and its question_root seam; corrosion's citation.py answer check.
challenge.real_collision: none: it reads the published question module's record, the interface reseal already uses (orchestrator, 2026-11-19).

answers.falsifier: Done when a withdrawn fixture is refused at rung 4 naming both ids while an answered one still lifts; wrong intent if a withdrawn question carries an answer.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is the sibling the withdraw ticket's bounds name (cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py out of its bounds), split under RULE 1 in CLAUDE.md
answers.how: In ruling_refusal (cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py), refuse when the record question.read returns carries withdrawn, naming its duplicate_of; red-first proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_rung_4_refuses_a_withdrawn_question.py.
answers.traces_to: Law 7: a record of truth stays true; an open duplicate says a decision is owed twice, and answering it to close it writes a decision nobody made.
answers.what: Rung 4 of the reseal door refuses a question withdrawn as a duplicate, so a record that decided nothing cannot lift it.

bullets.text: A new resolved-shape in a tool must be checked against every reader of resolved; the split keeps each reader's guard in its own component.

title: Rung 4 of the reseal door refuses a question withdrawn as a duplicate, so a record that decided nothing cannot lift it.
